entities.name: PsbJ
observations: The 40-residue query sequence exactly matches reviewed UniProt protein P59087 from Thermosynechococcus vestitus.
PsbJ is a single-pass thylakoid membrane component of the photosystem II reaction center.
A reviewed homolog annotation states PsbJ may play a regulatory role in photosystem II biogenesis.
The query has a predicted Pfam PsbJ domain (PF01788.23), positions 2–40, i-Evalue 7.9e-24.
Sequence-derived properties: molecular mass 4104.896 Da, theoretical pI 5.753, GRAVY 1.3325, and calculated pH 7 charge -0.4988.

entities.name: Photosystem II
observations: PsbJ is annotated as a component of the photosystem II core complex in cyanobacteria.
Photosystem II is a light-driven water:plastoquinone oxidoreductase that generates oxygen and a proton gradient.

entities.name: Photosynthesis
observations: The query protein is annotated with GO biological process GO:0015979, photosynthesis, through its PsbJ identity.
